start.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
start.text: The iron latch turned! I am free! The sentry at the watchtower has turned his back toward the lake.

choices.text: The Northern Gate is ahead. Once through, we run into the highland forests!

node_breakout_success.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_breakout_success.text: One thousand kilometers lie between us and the coast. We will walk every footstep until we stand once more in sacred Kaya Fungo!

events.value: Mekatilili and Wanje broke out of Kisii Prison on a moonlit night, vanishing into the Nyanza hills to begin their 1,000 km trek home.
